answer_1.quote: The relation extraction task aims to extract relations between named entities in a given text.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are relations between biomedical entities (e.g., drug-disease, gene-disease) in either unstructured text or structured JSON format.

answer_2.quote: We use the following metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the LLM-Judge. Exact Match Accuracy: Measures the Exact Match Accuracy of the LLM-Judge annotation in comparison to the human-annotated gold label... Root Mean Squared Error: Measures the Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) distance between the LLM-Judge annotation and the human-annotated gold label.

answer_3.quote: We propose a domain adaptation technique to address the lack of human-annotated judgment data by effectively transferring knowledge from out-of-domain data to improve the performance of LLM-Judges in the target domain.
methods: LLM-Judge evaluates LLM-Generator responses by comparing predicted relations to gold relations in a structured prompt and outputs JSON with counts of correct and total predicted relations

answer_4.quote: Two human annotators having backgrounds in NLP and biomedicine annotated the correctly predicted relations and the total predicted relations in the GPT-4-Turbo generated responses for both structured and unstructured cases.
answer_4.guideline: An annotation guideline is first constructed to evaluate the performance of the LLM-Generator (i.e., relation extraction LLM) by human annotators.
